Invalidate Redis cache after create/update/delete of feature flags and when user or segment overrides are modified. Prevents stale values from persisting for up to 1 hour after admin changes.

Await syncPeriodically() and wrap initial sync in try/catch so transient database or API failures during startup no longer trigger unhandled rejections and process shutdown.

* fix(api,database): return 404 when announcement deleted during update

When an announcement was deleted between the existence check and the
update/publish/archive operation, Drizzle's .returning() returned an
empty array. The code passed undefined to toAnnouncementDto, causing
TypeError and server crash. Now return 404 NOT_FOUND instead.

* fix(distributed-lock): extend expiresAt on heartbeat

Heartbeats previously updated only heartbeatAt, leaving expiresAt at the initial timeout. Locks could expire mid-job despite active heartbeats, allowing duplicate execution. Store per-lock timeout and extend expiresAt on each heartbeat so locks remain valid while heartbeats continue.

* fix(bot): prevent liveness probe restarts on dependency degradation

* fix(database): throw EntityNotFoundError when mod update matches no rows

* fix(auth): use dot separator in Steam trusted origins wildcard matching

Prevent multi-level subdomains from bypassing single-level subdomain restriction. With separator dot, patterns like https://*.example.com now match only app.example.com, not malicious.attacker.example.com.

* fix(www): add single-flight lock for concurrent token refresh

Prevent race condition where multiple concurrent requests refreshing an expired token could log users out. Only one refresh runs at a time; concurrent callers await the same result.

* fix(queue): apply defaultJobOptions to cron jobs

CronService now accepts queue options and forwards defaultJobOptions to the BullMQ Queue. Removes hardcoded opts in upsertJob and scheduleInterval so configured retries, backoff, and removeOnFail are respected. Update api and mirror-service to pass queue config.

* fix(api): rethrow Redis publish errors in ReportService

ReportService was catching and logging Redis publish failures without rethrowing. Callers received success responses while Discord moderators never got notifications. Rethrow after logging to match RedisPublisherService and allow proper error handling upstream.

* fix(api,auth): return 200 for health endpoint when degraded

Avoid mapping degraded status to 503 so Kubernetes probes do not restart pods when dependencies (DB/Redis) temporarily fail.

* fix(queue): nest job options in defaultJobOptions for BullMQ

BaseQueue was spreading job options at the Queue level instead of nesting them in defaultJobOptions. BullMQ ignores job-level options at the top level, so attempts, backoff, timeout, and removeOnComplete/removeOnFail were never applied. Jobs now correctly retry on transient failures and auto-remove completed/failed records.

* fix(mirror-service): validate Redis, S3, and database in health endpoints

Implement HealthService that checks DB, Redis, and S3 connectivity before reporting healthy. Return 503 when any dependency is unavailable so Kubernetes readiness/liveness probes fail and do not route traffic to unhealthy pods. Remove process.exit(1) from Redis error handler to allow health check to return 503 instead of crashing. Update infrastructure probes to use /health path.

* fix(api): add 10MB size limit to KV parse endpoint to mitigate DoS

Reject payloads exceeding 10MB before parsing to prevent resource exhaustion from oversized requests.

* fix(desktop): allow deleting and retrying mods after a failed download

purge_mod bailed with GamePathNotSet whenever game/citadel/addons was
absent, which is the normal state until an install succeeds. It returned
before removing the mod's download folder, so a mod whose download failed
could never be deleted and its card never left the list.

The addons-dependent VPK and manifest cleanup now runs only when that
directory exists, and resolving the mods store path moved to the caller so
the purge itself is testable without a Tauri AppHandle.

failedToDownload also only permitted a transition to Error, so setModStatus
rejected both the retry (-> Downloading) and its completion (-> Downloaded),
leaving the card stuck even when a retry succeeded.

* docs(contributing): add dbus and protobuf to Linux dependencies

libdbus-sys needs dbus-1.pc and prost-wkt-types needs protoc, pulled in
unconditionally through valveprotos and steam-vent. Without them a cold
cargo build fails in a build script, and so does the clippy pre-commit hook.

* fix(desktop): reject mod IDs that escape the mods store on purge

purge_mod joined an unvalidated mod ID onto the mods store path and deleted
the result recursively, so a traversing ID reached outside the store. The
check that get_validated_mod_folder_path already performed is now a shared
helper both paths call.

Drops the failedToDownload transition change, which #565 covers.
